provenance.note: third reader: as passed by its first chamber. The § 5-207(C) quote lists only some of the 16 prohibited-recipient categories (items 1-3, 15, 16; items 4-14 include drug, mental-health, protective-order, juvenile and intoxication bars). Struck by amendment: the broad "transfer" definitions (J)-(M), the exemptions for imminent-harm, estate and temporary range/hunting/in-presence loans, the "meet jointly with a licensee" step, a fee cap, and the 5-year penalty (now 6 months). Added: sale/rental wording, dealer-delivery option, religious photo-ID exemption, licensee civil immunity for malfunction, preemption and § 5-207. Section 2 (uncodified) states intent that "transfer" follow Chow v. State and exclude temporary gratuitous exchange. Passed Senate 31-14 and House 87-42 (March 2020); vetoed and overridden in 2021 (Senate 31-16, House 88-46). Amendments made after the version read are not in the text read.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-204.1(B)): A PERSON WHO IS NOT A LICENSEE MAY NOT COMPLETE A SALE, RENTAL, OR TRANSFER OF A RIFLE OR SHOTGUN OTHER THAN A REGULATED FIREARM, AS A PURCHASER, LESSEE, OR TRANSFEREE OR SELLER, LESSOR, OR TRANSFEROR, UNLESS THE PERSON IS IN COMPLIANCE WITH THIS SECTION.
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-204.1(C)(1)): BEFORE A SALE, RENTAL, OR TRANSFER IS CONDUCTED, THE SELLER, LESSOR, OR TRANSFEROR AND PURCHASER, LESSEE, OR TRANSFEREE SHALL BOTH REQUEST THAT A LICENSEE FACILITATE THE SALE, RENTAL, OR TRANSFER.
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-204.1(D)(1)): THE LICENSEE OR THE SELLER, LESSOR, OR TRANSFEROR MAY NOT COMPLETE THE SALE, RENTAL, OR TRANSFER TO THE PURCHASER, LESSEE, OR TRANSFEREE IF THE RESULTS OF THE BACKGROUND CHECK INDICATE THAT THE PURCHASER, LESSEE, OR TRANSFEREE MAY NOT POSSESS THE RIFLE OR SHOTGUN.
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-204.1(F)(1)): EXCEPT AS PROVIDED IN PARAGRAPH (2) OF THIS SUBSECTION, A PERSON WHO VIOLATES THIS SECTION IS GUILTY OF A MISDEMEANOR AND ON CONVICTION IS SUBJECT TO IMPRISONMENT NOT EXCEEDING 6 MONTHS OR A FINE NOT EXCEEDING $10,000 OR BOTH.
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-207(A)): THIS SECTION SUPERSEDES ANY RESTRICTION THAT A LOCAL JURISDICTION IN THE STATE IMPOSES ON THE TRANSFER BY A PRIVATE PARTY OF A RIFLE OR SHOTGUN, AND THE STATE PREEMPTS THE RIGHT OF ANY LOCAL JURISDICTION TO REGULATE THE TRANSFER OF A RIFLE OR SHOTGUN.
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-207(C)): A LICENSEE OR ANY OTHER PERSON MAY NOT SELL, RENT, TRANSFER, OR LOAN A RIFLE OR SHOTGUN TO A PURCHASER, LESSEE, TRANSFEREE, OR RECIPIENT WHO THE LICENSEE OR OTHER PERSON KNOWS OR HAS REASONABLE CAUSE TO BELIEVE: (1) HAS BEEN CONVICTED OF A DISQUALIFYING CRIME, AS DEFINED IN § 5–101 OF THIS TITLE; (2) HAS BEEN CONVICTED OF A VIOLATION CLASSIFIED AS A COMMON LAW CRIME AND RECEIVED A TERM OF IMPRISONMENT OF MORE THAN 2 YEARS; (3) IS A FUGITIVE FROM JUSTICE;
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-207(C)(15)–(16)): (15) IS A PARTICIPANT IN A STRAW PURCHASE; OR (16) INTENDS TO USE THE RIFLE OR SHOTGUN TO: (I) COMMIT A CRIME; OR (II) CAUSE HARM TO THE PURCHASER, LESSEE, TRANSFEREE, OR RECIPIENT OR ANOTHER PERSON.
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-207(D)): A PERSON WHO VIOLATES THIS SECTION IS GUILTY OF A MISDEMEANOR AND ON CONVICTION IS SUBJECT TO IMPRISONMENT NOT EXCEEDING 5 YEARS OR A FINE NOT EXCEEDING $10,000 OR BOTH.
